limits: Arinarnoa, Castets, Marselan and Touriga Nacional together: at most 5%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Malbec sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: Haut-Médoc is based on Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot, with Cabernet Franc and others. Six other appellations sit inside it, including Pauillac and Saint-Julien.
